findings.topic: CI job list and workflow outlines
findings.detail:
ci.yml (on: pull_request, push main; concurrency cancel-in-progress):
  setup steps common: actions/checkout@v5; pnpm/action-setup@v4; actions/setup-node@v6 {node-version-file: .node-version, cache: pnpm}; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile.
  job typecheck: `pnpm turbo run typecheck` (tsc -b at root, project references).
  job lint: `pnpm turbo run lint` + `prettier --check .`.
  job test-node: `pnpm turbo run test --filter=@taxiway/shared --filter=@taxiway/db` (Vitest 4.1).
  job test-workers: `pnpm --filter api test` (Vitest 4.1 + @cloudflare/vitest-plugin; FlightTracker lifecycle with runDurableObjectAlarm; needs no secrets; Hyperdrive tests use CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_DB pointing at a `services: postgres:17` container or skip DB paths).
  job test-mobile: `pnpm --filter mobile test -- --ci` (jest-expo).
  job db-migrations (pull_request only): neondatabase/create-branch-action@v6 {project_id: vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID, api_key: secrets.NEON_API_KEY, parent_branch: staging, expires_at: +1d} -> `drizzle-kit check` -> `drizzle-kit migrate` with DATABASE_URL=outputs.db_url -> `drizzle-kit generate --check` style drift guard (fail if schema and migrations diverge) -> neondatabase/delete-branch-action on PR close (separate workflow on pull_request: closed).
  job wrangler-dry-run: `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env staging` (catches binding/config errors without deploying).
deploy-staging.yml (on: push main; environment: staging; needs ci):
  migrate: `pnpm --filter @taxiway/db migrate` with DATABASE_URL=secrets.NEON_STAGING_DIRECT_URL.
  deploy: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4 {apiToken, accountId, workingDirectory: apps/api, packageManager: pnpm, environment: staging, command: deploy --env staging, secrets: AERODATABOX_KEY\nJWT_SECRET...}.
  smoke: curl https://api-staging.<domain>/health.
deploy-production.yml (on: push tags v*; environment: production with required reviewer + tag rule v*): same two steps with production secrets; `wrangler versions upload` + `wrangler versions deploy` optional for gradual rollout later.
mobile-preview.yml (on: workflow_dispatch, pull_request labeled 'build:preview'): expo/expo-github-action@v8 {eas-version: latest, token: secrets.EXPO_TOKEN}; `eas build --platform all --profile preview --non-interactive --no-wait`; separate job on every PR: `expo/expo-github-action/preview@v8` with `command: eas update --auto --branch pr-${{ github.event.number }}` (needs pull-requests: write).
mobile-release.yml (on: push tags v*): `eas build --platform all --profile production --auto-submit --non-interactive --no-wait` (iOS -> TestFlight, Android -> internal track per eas.json submit profile); EAS env 'production' holds EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL.
Secrets by GitHub environment: staging {CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, NEON_STAGING_DIRECT_URL, provider keys}, production {same, production values}; repo-level {NEON_API_KEY, EXPO_TOKEN, SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN}; variables {NEON_PROJECT_ID, TURBO_TEAM}.

findings.topic: Environments layout
findings.detail: local: `wrangler dev` (Miniflare/workerd in-process: DOs, KV, R2, Queues, alarms all emulated locally) + Postgres via either (a) docker `postgres:17` with CLOUDFLARE_HYPERDRIVE_LOCAL_CONNECTION_STRING_DB, or (b) Neon Local container creating an ephemeral branch off `staging` (closer to prod, needs network). `.dev.vars` for secrets. Mobile: `APP_VARIANT=development npx expo start` against a development build (expo-dev-client) with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://<lan-ip>:8787. staging: Worker `taxiway-api-staging` (wrangler env.staging), Neon branch `staging` (or separate project), KV/R2/Queues namespaces suffixed -staging, EAS profile preview + EAS env 'preview' pointing at api-staging.<domain>, bundle id `.preview`. production: Worker `taxiway-api-production` (or top-level name), Neon primary branch, EAS profile production, bundle id without suffix. Cloudflare Access in front of /admin routes on both. Sentry: two projects (mobile, workers) with `environment` tag = staging|production.

findings.topic: tsconfig / project references design
findings.detail: Root tsconfig.base.json: {strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noImplicitOverride, verbatimModuleSyntax, isolatedModules, module: ESNext, moduleResolution: bundler, target: ES2022, skipLibCheck}. packages/shared and packages/db: composite: true, declaration + declarationMap, rootDir src, outDir dist (types only; runtime consumers import TS source via package.json `exports` -> ./src/index.ts, which Metro, wrangler/esbuild and Vitest all handle). apps/api: composite, references shared + db, types ['@cloudflare/workers-types' via `wrangler types` output worker-configuration.d.ts]; emits `dist/types` .d.ts so mobile can import `AppType` from compiled declarations (Hono's own recommendation for tsserver speed). apps/mobile: extends expo/tsconfig.base AND the strict base (Expo's base is deliberately lenient; strict must be re-asserted), references shared + api(types). Root tsconfig.json: `files: [], references: [...]`; `typecheck` script = `tsc -b --pretty false`. Pin typescript ~6.0.3 in pnpm catalog until Expo supports 7.x (tracked by expo/expo#47627) and typescript-eslint gains TS 7 API support (7.1).

findings.topic: Items not verified live (stated from memory)
findings.detail: unverified (from memory): @commitlint/config-conventional + husky/lefthook specifics; GitHub Team plan price; `wrangler types` generating worker-configuration.d.ts; `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir`; DO SQLite migration key `new_sqlite_classes`; expo/expo-github-action `preview` sub-action exact input names beyond `command`; Detox support for RN 0.86; whether pnpm 12 defaults `minimumReleaseAge` to 1440 min (search result implies a built-in 1440-minute non-strict default; confirm before relying on it for supply-chain policy).

monorepo-ci.recommendation: 1) pnpm 12 workspaces (isolated linker, `nodeLinker: hoisted` as documented fallback) + Turborepo 2.11 for task graph/caching; Node 24 LTS via .node-version; pnpm pinned with package.json `packageManager` (Corepack is gone from Node 25+). Why: Expo SDK 54+ officially supports isolated pnpm and SDK 52+ auto-configures Metro for workspaces, Cloudflare's own monorepo guidance is pnpm+Turbo, and Nx/Bun add surface area without payoff at 4 packages. 2) Layout apps/mobile, apps/api, packages/shared, packages/db. Keep db separate from shared so the RN bundle never depends on drizzle/pg; shared holds zod schemas, DTOs, provider interfaces, flight-key normaliser, refresh-cadence and delay-model pure functions (tested once under Vitest). No packages/ui in Phase 0. TypeScript pinned ~6.0.3 repo-wide (Expo 57 constraint; TS 7.0 also lacks the API typescript-eslint needs), one strict tsconfig.base.json, project references with `tsc -b`, mobile re-asserts strict on top of expo/tsconfig.base. 3) Lint/format: ESLint 9 flat + Prettier 3 (eslint-config-expo for mobile, typescript-eslint type-checked elsewhere). Boring and what `npx expo lint` scaffolds; Biome 2.5 is a credible swap once its four React Native rules leave nursery. Tests: Vitest pinned ~4.1 (NOT 5.x) + @cloudflare/vitest-plugin 1.1.x (renamed from vitest-pool-workers) for api/shared/db with runDurableObjectAlarm/runInDurableObject for the FlightTracker lifecycle; Jest 29 via jest-expo 57 + RNTL for mobile. 4) CI on GitHub Actions with cloudflare/wrangler-action@v4 rather than Workers Builds: the deploy job must run drizzle migrations against Neon before `wrangler deploy --env staging|production` and be gated by GitHub Environments (required reviewer + tag rule on production); Workers Builds cannot express that ordering with env-scoped secrets. Per-PR Neon branch (create-branch-action@v6) runs `drizzle-kit check` + migrate + drift guard, deleted on close. EAS Build only on tag/manual/label (free tier is 15+15 builds/month); EAS Update `--auto` preview on every PR; `--auto-submit` on tags to TestFlight/Play internal. E2E deferred; Maestro when added. 5) Typed client: Hono RPC `hc<AppType>` with @hono/zod-validator, `strict: true` in both tsconfigs, API type emitted as .d.ts to keep tsserver fast; add hono-openapi later only for the MCP/public surface. 6) Identifiers: same reverse-DNS on both platforms derived from the final domain, suffix `.dev`/`.preview` for variants, no platform token; immutable after first upload/publish, so decide domain and org (D-U-N-S) before any TestFlight/Play upload. 7) First runnable milestone needs only: GitHub repo, Cloudflare account on Workers Paid ($5), Neon free project with `staging` branch, AeroDataBox key, Expo account (free) for a development build; Apple/Google/Sentry/RevenueCat can follow.
risks: Vitest 5 is npm `latest`; any `pnpm add -D vitest` without the catalog pin breaks the Workers test suite (peer ^4.1.0 on @cloudflare/vitest-plugin 1.1.13; workers-sdk#15618 open).

TypeScript 7.0.2 is `latest`; Expo 57 expects ~6.0.3 and app.config.ts fails to load under TS 7 (expo/expo#47627). Renovate must be configured to not bump typescript past 6.x until Expo ships support.

Miniflare 5 is published only as `-alpha` builds (5.20260918.0-alpha) yet is what wrangler 4.135 and the vitest plugin depend on; expect occasional breakage on wrangler bumps, so pin wrangler and the vitest plugin in the catalog and bump together.
Vitest-plugin known issue: DO alarms are not reset between test runs / do not respect isolated storage; FlightTracker lifecycle tests must deleteAlarm() in beforeEach and use unique DO ids per test.

pnpm isolated installs are officially supported only since SDK 54; a third-party native module with sloppy peer deps can still fail autolinking. The escape hatch (nodeLinker: hoisted) changes the whole repo's node_modules layout, so decide early and keep the ADR.
GitHub Environments (env-scoped secrets, required reviewers) are unavailable on GitHub Free for private repos; without Team/Pro the production gate degrades to branch protection only.
Bundle ID / Android application ID / App Store Connect SKU are immutable after first upload; uploading a TestFlight build with a placeholder domain locks it forever.

Google Play personal accounts created after 2023-11-13 need 12 testers for 14 continuous days before production access; an organization account (D-U-N-S, up to 30 days) avoids this but delays account creation.
EAS free tier is 15 iOS + 15 Android builds/month with a low-priority queue (90+ min at peak); a per-PR build policy will exhaust it in a week.
Hono RPC type inference degrades tsserver as routes grow; if the API type is not emitted as .d.ts and consumed via project references, mobile IDE latency will become a complaint by Phase 2.
Two test runners (Vitest + Jest) means two mocking idioms; keep provider adapters and pure logic out of apps/mobile so Jest only ever tests UI.

Workers Builds preview URLs are attractive later, but the dashboard Worker name must match wrangler config name and it cannot orchestrate Neon migrations; running both GHA deploys and Workers Builds against the same Worker will race.
alternatives_rejected: Nx: better affected-graph/generators/distributed execution, but forces its plugin model on Expo and wrangler workflows; unjustified at 4 packages.
Bun workspaces: fastest install but rudimentary task runner and Node-first toolchains (Metro, wrangler, EAS) gain nothing; Expo supports it, yet it is the least-documented path.

Biome as the sole linter/formatter today: React Native rules (noReactNativeLiteralColors, noReactNativeRawText, useReactNativePlatformComponents, noReactNativeDeepImports) only landed in 2.4.13 as nursery and Expo tooling (`expo lint`) assumes ESLint. Revisit after nursery promotion.
Vitest for React Native (vitest-native): community plugin, not documented by Expo or RNTL; Jest 29 via jest-expo is the boring supported path.

@hono/zod-openapi as the primary API style: forces createRoute/OpenAPIHono everywhere and has a hono-instance version-skew footgun with hc; OpenAPI codegen (orval) adds a generation step with no type benefit over hc for a first-party client.
Workers Builds git integration as the primary deploy: cannot sequence Neon migration before deploy under environment-scoped secrets with required reviewers; keep as optional preview-URL add-on.

Detox for e2e: gray-box depth is nice but New Architecture support is documented only through RN 0.84 with open 0.81.x sync issues; Maestro (also a first-class EAS Workflows job) is the lower-maintenance choice when e2e is added.
Corepack for pnpm pinning: no longer shipped with Node 25+; packageManager field + pnpm/action-setup is the durable mechanism.
Keeping drizzle schema inside apps/api: would let the mobile app transitively see pg/drizzle types and makes the migration job depend on the Worker package; packages/db is cheap and cleaner.
Changesets: no published packages; app/worker versions come from tags, eas.json autoIncrement and wrangler deploys.
Platform-specific identifiers like app.taxiway.ios.dev: needless divergence between iOS and Android IDs; complicates RevenueCat, deep links and any Firebase config.
open_decisions_for_owner: Domain and legal org name: determines reverse-DNS bundle identifier / Android application ID (immutable after first upload) and whether Apple/Google enrollment is individual or organization (organization requires D-U-N-S; Google personal accounts created after 2023-11-13 carry the 12-tester/14-day closed-testing gate).
GitHub plan: private repo needs GitHub Team/Pro for Environments (env-scoped secrets, required reviewers, tag rules); otherwise accept branch-protection-only gating or make the repo public.
Package identifier scheme approval: proposed `<tld>.<domain>.mobile` with `.dev` / `.preview` variants, same on both platforms.

pnpm linker policy: start isolated (recommended) and accept a possible one-time switch to hoisted if a native module misbehaves, or start hoisted for zero risk at the cost of stricter dependency hygiene.
Node baseline: 24 LTS (recommended) vs 26 (Current; becomes LTS October 2026).
Lint stack: ESLint+Prettier (recommended, boring) vs Biome now (faster, single tool, RN rules still nursery).
Local database default for contributors: docker postgres:17 (offline, zero cost) vs Neon Local ephemeral branches (prod-like, needs network and NEON_API_KEY per dev).
Neon topology for staging: branch of the production project (cheapest, shares compute quota) vs separate project (hard isolation, separate quota).
Turborepo remote cache: none (fine for one contributor), GitHub actions/cache on .turbo, or Vercel remote cache via OIDC.
EAS plan timing: stay on Free (15+15 builds/month) through Phase 0 with tag/manual-only builds, or move to Starter ($19) once PR builds are wanted.
Sentry account: Developer plan is single-user; if a second engineer joins, Team ($26/month) is required.
